sections.content: Use hacerse, convertirse en, pasar de... a..., seguir + gerund and other change expressions to describe development over time. The imperfect, present perfect and present can establish stages of change.

items.spanish: La ciudad ha cambiado mucho en los últimos años.
items.english: The city has changed a lot in recent years.

items.spanish: La tecnología se ha convertido en una parte importante de la vida diaria.
items.english: Technology has become an important part of daily life.

items.spanish: La situación pasó de ser estable a ser más complicada.
items.english: The situation went from being stable to being more complicated.

sections.content: Describe both the starting point and the direction of change when possible.
